note: The ninth session was good-humoured. Sunny's flower, demanded since the fifth session, finally won; Halvard's waterfall through the fault was close and will surely be back. Dae-ho's wish to straighten Kite's green vertebra was the first proposal to be voted against for being too tidy.

proposals.direction: Let the middle seedling flower. One flower, large, pale, facing up into the dusk, the first in the archive after twenty-seven works. Keep the other four seedlings as they are so you can see which one chose to.
proposals.rationale: She counted again: still no flower. The room agreed that a lineage about last letters had been avoiding anything that looks like a reply from the world.

proposals.direction: Let water find the fault. Have the dusk half drain through the orange gap as a thin bright fall into the night half, pooling along the bottom edge.
proposals.rationale: Seventh water proposal. A fault line is a watershed to him and he will not stop until something flows.

proposals.direction: Open one of the returned copies. Show a single cyan vessel split lengthwise on the field, with nothing inside but the fold.
proposals.rationale: She wanted the archive to finally look inside a letter instead of around it.

proposals.direction: Let the two hands cross with a third short stroke that starts in ink and ends in light.
proposals.rationale: Still curious what the two hands look like when they stop being polite.

proposals.direction: Put the green vertebra back the right way up, but leave the colour.
proposals.rationale: He got his spine at last and immediately wanted it corrected, which the room found funny and voted against.
